answer: In Proof of Agent, game-theoretic multi-agent auditing secures the execution kernel against Sybil swarms. High-stake verifiers audit interaction graphs by executing topological cut verifications across clusters; if an adversary simulates an orchard of fake identities to form a bridgehead, cut analysis isolates the fraudulent subgraph. Colluding clusters face stake slashing, enforcing a superlinear attacker cost at this defense jetty.
